r01.summary: Use collision-free keys for duplicate-instance provenance.
r01.fix: Encode the entire [targetId, dependent] pair unambiguously with a schema-backed JSON tuple codec instead of delimiter concatenation. Preserve first-occurrence order and identical-relationship deduplication. Add embedded-NUL collision and non-collision controls in DuplicateCheck.test.ts. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence to central bookkeeping; do not edit ledger or Port notes.

r02.fix: Pass a distinct $I-derived identifier, title and description directly to S.isPattern. Preserve REQUIRED_EDGE and validation behavior. Add a targeted metadata assertion in LayerPolicy.test.ts. No hand-written deviation entry.

r03.summary: Give the graph index payload a schema owner.
r03.fix: Define a module-local identity-annotated Edges structural schema and derive the existing type from .Type. Retain plain objects, immutable Effect collections, explicit vertex order and construction timing; do not introduce runtime rejection or an unnecessary export. Retain graph behavior tests and add a representation/ordering control in DependencyGraph.test.ts.

r04.summary: Recognize complete Unicode identifiers in boundary rules and exemptions.
r04.fix: Read complete raw identifier tokens and reuse Unicode cooking for console members and stdout receiver/write/end members. Make processReads and tokenOccurrences exemption end guards recognize escaped identifier continuations. Preserve raw UTF-16 offsets, optional/member access, receiver/private-name/comment controls and exact ignore-token semantics; retain the existing final-chunk rule. Add escaped permitted console methods, escaped longer names, escaped stdout receivers/members and default/custom exemption suffix regressions in SourceBoundary.test.ts, with identifier helper controls in sourceText.test.ts if needed. Any shared lexer helper/export belongs to the same owning group. Supply upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r05.summary: Detect optional stdout.end calls that pass a chunk.
r05.fix: Accept optional-call ?. before the argument parenthesis in the final-chunk check. Add chunk-bearing and empty optional-call controls in SourceBoundary.test.ts; preserve existing write/end distinctions and locations. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r06.summary: Require a file for the pnpm workspace marker.
r06.fix: Use fs.stat for the pnpm marker and require type === "File". Absorb per-probe errors as before and continue to the package.json check when the marker is a directory. Add directory-marker, real-file and ancestor controls in WorkspaceRoot.test.ts. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r07.summary: Reject traversal segments in config-dependency versions before resolving paths.
r07.fix: Validate hasTraversalSegment(entry.version) in declaredEntries before either resolver constructs paths, failing through the existing typed CatalogAssemblyError path. Add resolvePnpmfiles({pkg: "../../outside"}) refusal with no directory read or fetch and a valid single-segment version control; keep name validation. Tests belong to internal/configDependencyResolution.coverage.test.ts and integration/ConfigDependencyHooks.int.test.ts. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r08.fix: Use R.assignProperty(registries, scope, url). Add an own __proto__ scope plus a normal-scope control through registrySettingsOf and scratchWorkspaceYaml in internal/configDependencyFetch.coverage.test.ts. Preserve tolerant input handling and scope order. This file shares ownership with r11. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r09.summary: Classify division after spaced or repeated non-null assertions.
r09.fix: Walk backward over postfix ! tokens using lastCode to inspect the preceding significant operand. Preserve prefix logical negation and genuine-regex handling. Add spaced, commented and repeated assertion regressions plus division/regex controls in sourceText.test.ts and a public SourceBoundary.check regression in SourceBoundary.test.ts. Retain raw offsets and the adjacent-assertion pin; supply upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r10.summary: Exclude global-object spellings nested under local receivers.
r10.fix: Require the recognized receiver to be a free global-object reference or a verified global-object chain; reject unrelated member and optional-member receivers, retaining the spread exception. Preserve cooked identifiers, optional chaining and original offsets. Add local nested-object controls and genuine globalThis.process/global-object-chain controls in sourceText.test.ts and SourceBoundary.test.ts. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence centrally.

r11.summary: Use Schema JSON codecs in the remaining synchronous boundaries.
r11.fix: Use S.fromJsonString with Result/Option decode/encode codecs for these deliberate synchronous helpers, including a string JSON codec for YAML quoting and an appropriate document codec for consumer package.json. Preserve skip behavior, read/invalidJson/invalidShape classification, tolerant shape handling, formatting and trailing newlines (including packedInstallPlan.ts:281). Add/adjust assertions in WorkspacesSync.test.ts, WorkspacesSync.coverage.test.ts, PackedInstallPlan.test.ts, internal/packedInstallPlan.coverage.test.ts and internal/configDependencyFetch.coverage.test.ts. Supply law-forced SyntaxError-to-SchemaError cause changes and adjusted oracle assertions to central per-class bookkeeping; do not edit ledger/Port notes.
